# Process (solo)

One person, so no gates. Keep the loop tight.

1. Write down what you want before you start (a few lines is enough).
2. Let the agent work on a branch or straight on main, your call.
3. Run the tests. Read the diff yourself before you commit.
4. Note anything surprising in `CHANGELOG.md` so the next loop can learn from it.

You are the reviewer. If a mistake keeps happening, add a line to `AGENTS.md` or a check to your tests rather than relying on remembering.

Outgrowing this? Move to the `small-team` profile: copy its `PROCESS.md`, `ROLES.md` and PR template from the ai-sdlc-loop repo (`template/profiles/small-team/`).
